comments.author: Monarchy
comments.body:
According to official information from KOEI:
1) The performance written in the comments above (the performance written on the official website on September 6) are incorrect.
2) The current uploaded performance (the same performance that were previously released in Maris) is correct and are the same as what was confirmed in Japanese UWO.

However I'm worried about this:
If this ship released, there is a possibility of confusion for players because we already have Moonlight Flying Cloud from Ship Exchange Ticket (No.425). If all information including skill is the same as ship what is released in Maris, this is not our problem because we can use completely same ship. However, if the skill information is different, we are at risk of trading ship with the same name that does not include the desired skill.
